matched_caller_pairs.method: Parse objdump raw-byte instruction rows; remove instruction addresses and symbol/comment annotations. Internal branches become SELF+offset, external targets retain absolute address, RIP memory references retain resolved absolute target. For each direct-vs-outlined pair replace ONLY the two named arithmetic-leaf destinations with ARITH_LEAF. Preserve all mnemonics, registers, constants, other targets and order. Equality describes caller instructions excluding leaf destination/relocation, not equality of callee arithmetic or dynamic cost.
matched_caller_pairs.normalized_hash_encoding: SHA256 of ASCII instruction lines joined byLF with one finalLF.

cpuid_guard_check.scope: All retained full jobs and their selected normal arithmetic/serialization callees; existing cached FE64 API dispatch is separately visible and not removed.
cpuid_guard_check.existing_api_dispatch: mul_impl/square_impl retain cached asm_available guards, first-use feature detection calls and portable fallback branches. Direct ASM/outlined row callers do not enter these dispatchers.
cpuid_guard_check.caller_admission: native_asm_available checked outside all direct invocations by protocol/manager-reviewed source; this static task does not execute host-admission tests.

call_output_windows.name: row_mul_carry_sample
call_output_windows.parent_symbol: pa_p6_row_mul
call_output_windows.purpose: Scalar products/carry chains and explicit stack-relative operands.

findings: All4 GCC and4 Clang direct-vs-outlined caller pairs are instruction-identical after the explicitly scoped target/address normalization; actual arithmetic calls survive and target different intended leaves.
Direct and API paths target the SAME field_mul_full_asm or field_sqr_full_asm symbol within each binary; ASM raw bytes also match between GCC/Clang links.

All16 GCC jobs contain their evaluator bodies. Clang emits calls to separate evaluators for all four row-inline cells and API multiply ILP4; those callees are retained and cannot be excluded when interpreting symbol size.

GCC row leaves inline reduction, have22/16 multiply sites for mul/square, and are1244/1300 bytes. Clang row leaves are445/379 bytes with16/10 product multiply sites and a call to330-byte reduce_serial.

Clang reduce_serial has5 MULX sites, using conditional selection for the final overflow*K fold; its final subtract-p selection contains a result-dependent branch at0x18cc7. No CT guarantee follows from source mask arithmetic.

Clang row-inline chain evaluators call reduce_serial each step. Clang row-inline ILP4 evaluators inline the reductions, unroll4lanes, have84/60 static MULX sites, and include packed integer ADD/SUB in reduction/correction. No packed integer MUL is inferred.

GCC row-inline bodies have scalar lane loops and6 reducer multiply sites per lane body. GCC and Clang differ in visibility, scheduling, output materialization and liveness; inline vsoutlined is not only call cost.
GCC measure retains indirect job call0x1d95f/backedge0x1d969->0x1d950; initial clock0x1d90a/checkpoint0x1d975; continuous extension0x1d9ef->0x1d940 preserves begin.
Clang measure retains calibration loop0xc27a/backedge0xc280->0xc270 and extensible loop0xc31a/backedge0xc320->0xc310. Begin0xc245 is shared; checkpoint clocks0xc282/0xc32a occur after counted work.
All32 inspected GCC/Clang jobs store4x32B output at offsets0,32,64,96. Chain1 zeroes96 inactive bytes; ILP4 stores four canonicalBE32 results.

Explicit stack-relative operands occur in C++ arithmetic and caller state handling; ASM leaves save/restore registers with PUSH/POP but arithmetic uses registers without explicit RSP/RBP-relative memory operands. This is not a spill-cost or bandwidth measurement.

disassembly_slices.raw_byte_coverage: Complete contiguous coverage of [start,end_exclusive), verified against nm size.

replay_notes: Execute each command_args array; compare exact stdout to disassembly and SHA256 to disassembly_sha256.
Parse instruction byte columns, concatenate decoded bytes, verify count/end against nm extent, and SHA256 against raw_bytes_sha256.
mangled_name/mangled_aliases are from raw nm; nm_line is from demangled nm. Symbol extents are individual, not transitive hot-path sizes.
Recompute caller normalization independently from retained raw instruction text; eight worker booleans are evidence summaries, not a substitute for manager replay.
Raw instruction bytes cover every byte of all66 retained symbol extents contiguously; no zero-padding or inferred instructions added.
limitations: Static executable inspection only; no runtime gain, dynamic instruction count, cache/PMU/port/bandwidth or spill-cost attribution.
No CT certification; explicit Clang correction branch retained as a limitation.
Existing cached API dispatch includes initial feature tests; no new native admission check was inserted into direct hot routes.
Matched caller instructions do not equate unlike arithmetic leaves or their security domains.
Separate C++ symbols may be outlined by the compiler even when source wrappers are inline; report actual call closure.
No source/production modifications, settings changes or benchmark execution by this worker.
